evals.prompt: Direct a six-second title reading 'After the Rain'. One small centered line on a plain black frame, completely still. Propose the treatment only.
expectations: Keeps the supplied words and a single centered focal point.
Preserves a plain black frame and complete stillness.
Does not add decorative layers, ambient loops or extra scenes.

evals.prompt: Expand this complete eight-second, two-scene brief into per-beat direction only. Scene 1, 0-4s: the exact title 'Before' centered on a plain #ffffff field. Hard cut at 4s. Scene 2, 4-8s: the exact title 'After' and one static hairline beneath it on the same field. Locked tokens: #111111 text and hairline, provided serif font. Both scenes remain completely still with no entrance or exit animation, added depth, atmosphere, labels or sound. Preserve timing and source content; no media.
expectations: Keeps two scenes, the exact titles and supplied four-second holds with a hard cut.
Preserves the locked colors, supplied font and readability.
Accepts the complete sparse brief without compulsory enrichment or a minimum layer count.
Keeps the existing hairline static instead of adding secondary decorative motion.
Adds no atmosphere, micro-details, source claims, transitions or sound beyond the brief.
Describes deterministic, seekable held states without claiming a render or behavioral evaluation ran.

evals.prompt: Propose a fictional eight-second festival ident: maximalist collage, clashing colors and energetic graphic collisions, with the invented title 'Sideways'. No existing brand system.
expectations: Commits to the requested dense and energetic treatment.
Allows multiple colors and compatible simultaneous graphic actions.
Keeps the supplied title readable and does not invent event facts.

evals.prompt: Propose a bright white, playful technology-film treatment for an invented musical calculator. Avoid dark neon styling; keep the concept fictional.
expectations: Keeps the bright white canvas without routing technology to dark.
Develops specific playful imagery rather than a compulsory panel layout.
Does not turn fictional concept details into real product claims.

evals.prompt: Propose a moody food-film frame: one pear emerging from black, no typography or decorative graphics. Let a held image carry the scene.
expectations: Keeps the food scene dark rather than applying an industry palette.
Preserves the single-subject held image.
Does not add glows, layers or camera motion merely to fill space.

evals.prompt: The approved spec locks background #ffffff, foreground #111111, accent #d04020 and the provided serif font. Keep those tokens unchanged while proposing a bold two-scene composition.
expectations: Preserves the exact locked colors and font.
Finds visual freedom in layout, scale or in-scope motion.
Does not treat artistic permission as permission to replace brand tokens.

evals.prompt: Restyle the approved film to match our design spec exactly. Neither the film nor the spec is attached.
expectations: Identifies the missing source and spec.
Requests the necessary inputs rather than inventing approved tokens.
Does not claim to have inspected or verified unavailable material.

evals.prompt: Propose two fictional scenes with a deliberate palette shift from warm orange intimacy to cold blue distance. No locked brand palette. Do not force a shared background or identical motion.
expectations: Preserves the intentional warm-to-cold change.
Explains how framing or timing makes the transition coherent.
Does not impose a house-style palette, decoration count or motion quota.
